blocks.text: An updated modern icon, Calvin Klein’s bestselling thong for women combines a panty line-free look with the all-day comfort of your favorite essential pair.                          NEW YORK, NY, 10018 US

items.label: STRETCH COTTON
items.value: Made in premium cotton with a hint of Elastane, CK’s XXX for women are lightweight, ultra-soft and breathable.

items.label: LESS IS MORE
items.value: With minimal rear coverage, Calvin Klein’s thong panties for women flatter under any bottom.

items.label: BREATHABLE COMFORT
items.value: This no-show underwear for women has a full, pure cotton gusset for complete comfort and natural breathability.

items.label: FLEXIBLE WAISTBAND
items.value: The soft stretch waistband stays put without pulling and offers excellent shape retention.

items.label: EASY CARE
items.value: Calvin Klein’s womens underwear is entirely machine washable, for easy, stress-free care.

items.label: DESIGNED IN THE USA
items.value: Calvin Klein underwear is created by its NYC-based global design team using premium imported materials.
